base_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a new standalone wide 16:9 full game scene concept for a Korean ready-mix concrete plant conveyor safety training game. Three reference inputs: image 1 is the industrial environment, material, palette and afternoon light reference; image 2 is the exact Korean worker identity and full-body outfit reference; image 3 is that same worker's multi-angle consistency reference. Preserve that ONE Korean man in his 40s and his realistic proportions, white unbranded hard hat with chin strap, navy workwear, worn yellow reflective vest, gray gloves and worn safety boots. He is the foreign-material removal worker, NOT an operator. Narrative moment: beginning of the task, before energy isolation and personal lock attachment, safely outside all conveyor danger areas. Conveyor is visibly stopped, guards and maintenance access closed. The worker has a small red personal padlock with a blank yellow tag carried on his belt, NOT already attached to the disconnect. Depict a dedicated gray lockable conveyor energy-isolating disconnect with handle and credible physical locking provision, separate from the operator control panel; no claim of site engineering certification. No one inside the machinery, no hands near rollers, no tools contacting belt. At most ONE human, no duplicates. Near-photographic industrial game background, predominantly side-on human-eye-level side-scrolling composition, believable long horizontal conveyor and walkable grated maintenance walkway at realistic scale. Gray steel framing, black rubber belt, gray-brown aggregates and concrete, ochre-yellow railings, mild rust, worn paint, dusty used materials. Warm low afternoon sun from rear right through the open factory structure, cool gray indoor shadows and a few warm task lights. Background aggregate piles and connected conveyors. Keep the worker's entire body visible, both feet clearly on safe walkway with realistic scale; front rails should not obscure his whole torso. Avoid impossible duplicated railings, floating fans, disconnected stairs, inaccessible walkways. No cartoon, pixel art, low poly, miniatures, neon. STRICTLY NO titles, buttons, logos, watermarks, cursors, UI, inspection numbers, readable writing or fake lettering anywhere, including panels and tags. NO accidents, explosions, injuries or blood. Single continuous image, not a collage or sheet. Environment must show a plausible route from starting position toward isolation before maintenance, not depict entry into the belt area.
correction_prompt: Edit this game scene with surgical changes only. Keep the scene composition, aspect ratio, Korean worker identity and pose, full body, clothing, factory equipment positions, railings, sunlight, color and material texture EXACTLY unchanged. Remove EVERY bit of text or fake text or printed graphics from all electrical cabinets, isolator handle plates, motor plates and every yellow tag, including the tiny tag hanging at the worker's waist. Replace label contents with plain weathered metal or completely blank yellow tag surfaces. Remove any padlock or tag that is currently ATTACHED to the actual energy-isolating disconnect handle on the gray cabinet: this is the STARTING scene BEFORE the worker applies his personal lockout. Keep that isolator's handle and physical locking provision intact but empty. Preserve the one small red personal padlock and blank yellow tag carried at the worker's waist. Do not add any other locks, humans, UI, text, arrows or overlays. No accident, injury, blood. Do not redesign or move anything. Maintain photographic realism.

candidates.prompt: Start variant A: worker stands on the safe walkway near the LEFT side of frame, outside the closed maintenance access that contains lodged aggregate, looking toward the RIGHT. The actual energy-isolating disconnect is far right at the guarded drive assembly. Wide long conveyor separates the worker start and the destination, communicating that he must walk to apply isolation before returning for cleanup. Medium-wide camera, clearly legible physical objects without labels.

Start variant B: worker enters the safe maintenance walkway from the RIGHT side of frame, pauses facing LEFT, slightly back from a gray isolating disconnect situated right-center beside the guarded drive. The closed cleanup access lies farther left along the conveyor. Include an understated safe pedestrian entry at the right edge. No operator desk start. The whole spatial route is visible; no padlock installed.

Start variant C: worker stands near the CENTER of the safe grated walkway, side profile facing right, looking toward a guarded stationary conveyor and visible aggregate accumulation behind closed maintenance access to his left. Lockable energy isolator lies farther right. Spacious balanced composition around the lone worker, suitable for the opening task request overlay later, but draw absolutely no overlays or text. Full body clear and realistic in scale.

Start variant D: extra-wide establishing composition within a 16:9 frame, longer visible conveyor run and plant architecture. Worker is at LOWER LEFT on the safe walkway, small but fully readable at physically correct scale; closed cleanup access nearby and dedicated lockable isolator far RIGHT. Deep background aggregate stockpiles and conveyors, strong but natural afternoon light from right. Clearly continuous safe walking route. Show facility context and the distance to the lockout point without hiding it behind columns.
